chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Isa al-Farra', from 'Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur. He said: I heard Abu 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) saying: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever's outward appearance is weightier than his inner self, his Scale [of deeds] will be lightened.

key_terms.أرجح: Weightier, more preponderant — comparative of rajaha (to outweigh)
key_terms.باطنه: His inner self, internal reality, spiritual sincerity
key_terms.ظاهره: His outward appearance, external conduct, visible religious behavior
key_terms.ميزانه: His Scale of deeds — the eschatological balance of good deeds on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about those whose outward deeds outweigh their inner sincerity?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), as reported by Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), warns that a person whose outward religious show exceeds their inner spiritual reality will find their scale of good deeds diminished on the Day of Judgment. This teaching addresses the grave danger of hypocrisy and ostentation (riya'), where one performs visible acts of worship without genuine inner sincerity. The Scale (mizan) here refers to the eschatological measure of deeds at the Day of Resurrection, reflecting the Quranic teaching that only sincere deeds carry weight.
word_analysis: al-Baqir (the one who splits open knowledge)

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (ra) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b `Abdullah narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from `Isa al-Fara’ from `Abdullah b. Abi Ya`fur. He said: I heard Aba `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) say: Abu Ja`far al-Baqir (as) said:
Whoever’s appearances are weightier [in deeds] than his inside, his Scale [of good deeds] will be lightened.
